project: Wuxia Life P45 Personality Habit Trajectory Quantitative Validation
description: Validate whether the existing long-term shaping mechanism can consistently steer whole-life growth direction across replay samples, and classify weak cases without prematurely expanding into sample-line packaging or runtime rewrites.

userStories.title: Define quantitative validation questions and success bar
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want an explicit validation contract for the shaping mechanism so later replay evidence is judged against a stable bar rather than intuition.
acceptanceCriteria: Define the core validation questions for directional steering, cumulative divergence, late-outcome traceability, and weak-sample interpretation
Define pass, warning, and fail interpretation for this stage
Define the minimum evidence bundle required before declaring the mechanism quantitatively validated
Save the contract under docs/test-reports/p45-trajectory-validation-contract.md
Do not change gameplay behavior in this story
userStories.notes: Docs-only foundation story. Use it to prevent drifting standards later in the stage.

userStories.title: Define replay persona matrix and seed coverage
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a bounded replay matrix of personas, tendencies, and seeds so validation has enough coverage without becoming open-ended simulation work.
acceptanceCriteria: Define a replay matrix covering at least martial, scholarly, business, and mixed tendencies
Specify fixed seeds and target age windows for each persona
Document the early-life choices or action preferences that represent the intended shaping push
Save the matrix under docs/test-reports/p45-replay-persona-matrix.md
Keep the matrix small enough to run repeatedly in future regression loops
userStories.notes: Execution-sized planning story that fixes the sample set before any harness expansion.

userStories.title: Add deterministic trajectory replay harness
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a deterministic replay harness for shaping validation so I can rerun the same life samples and compare trajectories over time.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a bounded script or test surface that runs the replay matrix deterministically
Output includes major age checkpoints, dominant shaping axes, key route or identity signals, and notable outcome deltas
Output is readable in terminal and exportable to docs/test-reports/
The harness does not require manual UI play to reproduce the same sample set
Add regression coverage for output shape or fixture stability
userStories.notes: Single technical story. Keep output compact and evidence-oriented.

userStories.title: Produce trajectory differentiation report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a concrete report comparing replay outcomes across personas so I can see whether shaping actually produces materially different life directions.
acceptanceCriteria: Generate a report comparing the replay matrix by persona and seed
Call out where trajectories materially diverge and where they collapse together
Include at least one comparison each for growth emphasis, route or identity drift, midlife consequence pattern, and life-memory or recap differentiation
Save the report under docs/test-reports/p45-trajectory-differentiation-report.md
Avoid vague conclusions without evidence snippets
userStories.notes: Evidence synthesis story. Depends on the replay harness but not on later remediation.

userStories.title: Add early-choice to later-outcome traceability slice
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want at least one explicit traceability slice from early shaping choices to later outcomes so the mechanism can be defended as causal rather than coincidental.
acceptanceCriteria: Select representative replay samples from at least 3 shaping directions
For each sample, document early shaping choices or action patterns, state accumulation on habit or semi-personality axes, and later consequence, identity, or summary differences
Prefer a small curated evidence path over raw internal dumps where clearer
Save the slice under docs/test-reports/p45-early-choice-to-outcome-trace.md
If traceability is weak, explicitly mark the break point
userStories.notes: Causality-proof story. This is the clearest answer to the user's current concern.

userStories.title: Classify weak samples and route follow-up buckets
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want weak or collapsed replay samples classified by root cause so future optimization does not immediately jump to runtime rewrites.
acceptanceCriteria: Define small failure buckets such as thin content coverage, low trigger density, weak shaping signal, late or opaque consequence callback, and route differentiation collapse
Map weak replay samples into those buckets
Distinguish needs-more-content cases from needs-mechanism-adjustment cases
Save the classification report under docs/test-reports/p45-weak-sample-classification.md
Leave a clear defer queue for the next optimization stage
userStories.notes: Prevents broad unfocused rewrites by routing future work precisely.

userStories.title: P45 regression and closure
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want closure evidence that the shaping mechanism is quantitatively validated across replay samples, not just locally tested.
acceptanceCriteria: Run typecheck
Run existing shaping regressions relevant to replay validation
Run the new replay harness
Save closure under docs/test-reports/p45-trajectory-validation-closure.md
State explicitly whether the mechanism is runtime-complete only, quantitatively validated, or still blocked by specific weak-sample classes
userStories.notes: Final closure story. This is the approval gate before moving to sample-line work.
